subCards.title: No wheelchair available, 80-year-old collapses and dies after walk from plane to terminal
subCards.abstract: An 80-year old man who flew in with his wife, both of them booked as wheelchair passengers on an Air India flight from New York, collapsed at Mumbai airport immigration counter and died on Monday. The deceased was an Indian-origin, US-passport holder. They had pre-booked the wheelchair facility. The couple was booked in economy class of Mumbai-bound Air India flight AI-116 that left New York on Sunday.

images.title: No wheelchair available, 80-year-old collapses and dies after walk from plane to terminal

highlights.text:
**Elderly man dies at Mumbai airport**

- An 80-year old man who flew in from New York with his wife collapsed at Mumbai airport immigration counter and died on Monday due to a heart attack.
- The couple had pre-booked wheelchair assistance, but only one wheelchair was available for them. The wife sat on the wheelchair, while the husband walked about 1.5 km to reach the immigration area.
- Air India said that it was an unfortunate incident and that it was in constant touch with the family members of the bereaved. It also said that there was a heavy demand for wheelchairs and that the passenger opted to walk along with his spouse.

**Wheelchair shortage at Mumbai airport**

- There were 32 wheelchair passengers on the Air India flight from New York, but only 15 wheelchairs with accompanying staff on ground waiting for them.
- A ground staffer said that many aged couples prefer to stay with each other when moving from the aircraft through the terminal building and that some passengers seeking wheelchair assistance don't have any mobility issues.
- Air India used to charge for the wheelchair facility and require a medical certificate, but it did away with these requirements following pressure from various groups.

cards.title: 5 reasons why walnuts should be soaked before eating
cards.abstract: Soaking walnuts overnight can potentially reduce the risk of allergic reactions or sensitivities in some individuals. It helps lower the presence of tannins, improving the overall safety and enjoyment of consuming walnuts.

images.title: 5 reasons why walnuts should be soaked before eating

highlights.text:
The article explains ***why and how to soak walnuts before eating them***, and what benefits this process can offer. It covers:

- **Nutrients** in walnuts, such as fiber, vitamin E, folate, magnesium, phosphorus, omega-3 fatty acids, and plant-based protein, and how they support various body functions and health benefits.
- **Why to soak walnuts**, which helps to break down enzyme inhibitors and phytic acid in the nuts, making their nutrients more bioavailable and easier to digest, reducing bitterness, improving texture, and potentially lowering allergen sensitivities.
- **Five reasons** why soaking walnuts is beneficial, which are:
    - **Improved digestion**, by reducing digestive discomfort and enhancing nutrient absorption.
    - **Enhanced nutrient absorption**, by making the nutrients more accessible to the body.
    - **Reduced bitterness**, by making the nuts more palatable and enjoyable to eat.
    - **Improved texture**, by softening the nuts and making them easier to chew and digest.
    - **Potential allergen reduction**, by lowering the risk of allergic reactions or sensitivities to certain compounds in raw walnuts.

highlights.text: ***Nithin Kamath***, the founder and CEO of **Zerodha**, **warned investors** about a new scam originating from **China** and other Asian countries, in which **phishing websites** replicate the websites of **Indian brokerages** to deceive people. He said that clicking on the **download links** on these websites will prompt users to download the **fake app**, which can **transfer money** by taking advantage of their familiarity with these apps. He also shared his **old tweet** with some **tips** to avoid these scams, such as never replying to unknown messages, not reacting in a hurry, not sharing personal or financial information, and going to the nearest police station or lawyer if in doubt. He noted that **India has banned more than 100 investment scam websites** operated by **Chinese entities** that have been **targeting Indian citizens**.

cards.abstract: Undefined infection around teeth and gum or an excruciating pain can indicate mouth cancer. Here are signs of mouth cancer you shouldn't ignore.

highlights.text:
The article explains the signs of ***mouth cancer*** and how to prevent it with proper dental care and lifestyle modifications. It covers:

- The role of **tobacco chewing**, **supari**, **pan masala**, and other substances in increasing the risk of mouth cancer, especially among Indian men.
- The symptoms of **cancer of the gums or jaw**, such as *sore that does not heal*, *loose teeth*, *swollen gums*, *jaw pain*, and *difficulty swallowing*.
- The signs of **oral cancer** in other parts of the mouth, such as *changes in voice*, *difficulty moving the jaw*, *dental changes*, and *persistent mouth sores*.
- The advice to **rule out diabetes** and **get a biopsy** if the sore does not heal, and to **seek expert help** for any suspicious lesion or ulcer.
- The importance of **early detection** and **timely intervention** for improving treatment outcomes and prognosis of mouth cancer.

cards.title: HDFC Bank to launch two new types of loans
cards.abstract: HDFC Bank’s market share in the retail home loan segment has risen by 20% on incremental disbursement, and it is seeing 3.6% growth sequentially – the highest amongst peers.

images.title: HDFC Bank to launch two new types of loans

highlights.text: The article announces that ***HDFC Bank*** plans to launch **two new types of loans** in the coming months: the *Home Saver* product, an overdraft facility similar to **SBI's Maxgain scheme**, and the *Home Refurbishment* loan, which will be relaunched soon. Both products will be offered to **existing and new customers**. The Home Saver product is likely to be **100 basis points higher** than the bank's current home loan rates, which range from **8.55% to 9.10%**. HDFC Bank has seen a **20% rise in its market share** in the retail home loan segment, with a **3.6% sequential growth**. Home loans have become both an **asset and liability generator** for the bank, boosting its **CASA ratio** from 38% to 43% of its total deposits. HDFC Bank also said that **all erstwhile HDFC service centres** will be converted into branches in a **phased manner**.

cards.abstract: mid the recent political developments within the Congress, former party leader and Democratic Progressive Azad Party (DPAP) President Ghulam Nabi Azad on Wednesday said that it is unfortunate that the grand old party is coming to an end due to the weaknesses and arrogance of a few people. Azad told ANI that the exit of former Maharashtra CM Ashok Chavan from the party, is a big blow for the Congress.

highlights.text:
**Former Congress leader Azad comments on Chavan's exit**
- Ghulam Nabi Azad, the president of DPAP and a former Congress leader, said that Ashok Chavan's exit from the party is a big blow for the Congress.
- He said that Chavan has a significant contribution to Congress and his father was also a big leader and a Union Minister.
- He said that more people will leave the party in the coming times and that the party is coming to an end due to the weakness and arrogance of a few people.

**Chavan joins BJP and praises Sonia Gandhi**
- Ashok Chavan, the former Maharashtra CM, quit Congress and joined BJP in the presence of deputy chief minister Devendra Fadnavis.
- He said that he left the Congress after observing the mood of the nation and that he respects Sonia Gandhi.
- He said that he won't comment on Congress and whatever happens in the party will be their karma.
